top_signals.title: AI Rout Deepens; Anthropic Revenue Hits $16.8B; Warsh to Speak in Bangkok
top_signals.summary: US equity futures fall as a selloff in AI-related stocks gathers speed, pushing investors toward bonds. Investors await PPI, retail sales and jobless claims data as well as Fed Chair Warsh's remarks in Bangkok. Sources say Anthropic told prospective investors its third-quarter revenue hit $16.8 billion as it plans to go public soon. Kelsey Berro of JPMorgan Asset Management looks ahead to economic data and Chair Warsh's comments. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
